title: Persona intent audit returns what each session proposed and decided; only private memory stays hidden
owned_layer: BFF persona intent projection (_persona_intent_trace_item, _persona_intent_trainer_item, _persona_intent_agora_item, _persona_intent_redaction, _persona_intent_filter_items, _persona_intent_summary) and GET /bff/management/persona-intent kind filter

reproduction_2026_11_20.source: Coordinator hosted read-only sweep of 67 Management pages on 2026-11-20 (01:00Z-01:30Z)
observed_defects: All 14 items returned by GET /bff/management/persona-intent were marked redacted with policy 'management_persona_intent_public_summary'
Every item had userIntentSummary / summary identical to title, personaInterpretation empty ('—'), proposedAction empty ('—'), and toolsUsed empty ('[]')

Agora consultation 'agora_session:consult-envelope-publication-98f3c36b851627e3814268877ddb33db' ('Risk review of paper envelope publication of pool v3 (live membership changed)', status 'in_progress' since 2026-11-19T10:06:11Z, persona 'persona-ee7112a829d38b9135ac') was listed in the default trade intent audit list and listed only its own persona ID as consultedPersonas

Agora deliberative meetings (e.g. 'agora_session:mtg-16d42d0b44dfeab5', intent 'persona_meeting') and teaching advisories ('creq-teach-*') were also mixed into the default trade intent list without a kind separator

acceptance_verification.ac1_reproduce_first: Cited coordinator hosted reads 2026-11-20 (BFF fb8ed951d, mgmt-readability-sweep-20261120) and reproduced exact consult-envelope-publication-98f3c36b851627e3814268877ddb33db and mtg-16d42d0b44dfeab5 shapes in test_persona_intent_reproduces_hosted_20261120_sweep_and_separates_kinds_and_strips_private_memory.
acceptance_verification.ac2_sd_persona_meetings_12_2_facts_and_p: Each item returns topic, outcome, decision, proposed_action, tools_used (and tool_path), and consulted_personas; _persona_intent_strip_private_content recursively removes all private memory and private interpretation fields and scope:persona_private items before projection, verified by test assertion that secret values and private field keys are absent.
acceptance_verification.ac3_kind_classification_and_default_filt: Each item carries kind in {'trade_intent', 'consultation', 'meeting', 'trainer'}; GET /bff/management/persona-intent accepts kind query parameter and defaults to trade_intent when kind and source_type are omitted.
acceptance_verification.ac4_withheld_field_reason_codes: Withheld fields carry structured reason_code entries ('private_memory_withheld', 'private_interpretation_withheld', 'raw_control_diff_withheld') in item.withheld_fields, item.withheld_reason_codes, and item.redaction; 'management_persona_intent_public_summary' is replaced by 'sd_persona_meetings_12_2_private_memory_boundary'.
acceptance_verification.ac5_persona_display_names_next_to_ids: Items carry persona_display_name / persona_name / persona_label next to persona_id, plus personas, persona_display_names, and consulted_personas entries carrying {'id', 'persona_id', 'name', 'display_name'}.
